title: AI-Monitors at SemEval-2026 Task 4: A Hybrid Embedding and LLM Ensemble for Narrative Similarity
abstract: Proposed a hybrid system combining embedding-based similarity and structured LLM prompting with complementarity-driven ensembling.

title: Fast and Scalable Machine-Generated Text Detection
abstract: Built a multilingual detection system for GenAI text; improved F1 via optimization of training parameters.

title: Explainable AI for Depression Detection
abstract: Used BERT and SHAP for interpretable mental health classification from social media text.

title: Advancement of AI Tools in Precision Agriculture: Managing Logistics for Sustainable Agribusinesses
abstract: Presented a framework leveraging AI-driven analytics and intelligent logistics for improving efficiency, sustainability, and decision-making in agricultural supply chains.

title: On Developing Seed Information System-Guided Digital Governance Framework: Managing Seed Supply Chains in Marginalised Farming Ecosystems
abstract: Proposed a digital governance framework for seed supply-chain management, integrating information systems, traceability, and data-driven decision support for marginalized farming communities.
